findings: Energy from the preceding vocal decays after approximately65.00s; there is no coherent held vowel spanning65.35–65.65s in the separated vocal spectrum.
A low-level gap occurs65.35–65.45s (median40ms RMS bins−55.4 and−56.6dBFS), between preceding decay and a distinct rise around65.46s.

The later rise contains strong broadband/high-frequency energy around65.50–65.70s, followed by harmonic growth around65.78s. It must not be assigned to the preceding word solely because it is vocal-stem energy.

Without hearing/human labels these observations do not decide whether later noise is inhalation or a linguistic fricative; phonetic identity and independent ASR may disambiguate but are not reference truth.
